summary: Iteration 6 (TTS) fully validated. Backend: 12/12 pytest passed - POST /api/ai/tts returns {url:'/ai/tts-audio/<64hex>.mp3'} (200); GET /api/ai/tts-audio/<key>.mp3 returns 200 with Content-Type audio/mpeg and non-empty body (~15-40KB); empty/whitespace-only text -> 400; invalid non-hex key -> 404 (regex-guarded); valid 64-hex key that was never generated -> 404; cache verified (same text -> same url). Regression on /api/prices, /api/ai/chat, /api/ai/commentary, /api/ai/portfolio-advice, /api/ai/transcribe (400/422 for empty) all green. Frontend (mobile 390x844): /assistant screen sent 'Merhaba', assistant reply received with 'Sesli oku' button (testID ai-speak-1) present on the assistant bubble; tapping it toggled the button text to 'Durdur' (icon changed to stop-circle) and did NOT crash. Audio playback was successfully initiated via expo-audio createAudioPlayer.replace({uri}).play() flow. No red screen or console errors related to TTS. No deprecated packages detected.
critical_code_review_comments: TTS endpoint correctly SHA-256 caches by (text|voice|speed|model|fmt) to disk under tempfile.gettempdir()/onlinekur_tts (server.py:1036-1047). Cache-hit path skips OpenAI call - verified in test_tts_cache_same_key.
GET /ai/tts-audio/{key}.mp3 is regex-guarded with re.fullmatch(r'[a-f0-9]{64}', key) (server.py:1052) - prevents path traversal. Verified with invalidkey.mp3 -> 404.
clean_for_tts strips URLs, markdown, code blocks and emoji before hashing/synthesis (server.py:836-842) - keeps audio clean for Turkish speech.
Frontend api.aiTts prefixes backend URL to returned relative /ai/tts-audio/... path (client.ts:77-80) so expo-audio player receives an absolute URL - correct.

Assistant screen uses a module-level ttsPlayer = createAudioPlayer() and toggles playback via ttsPlayer.replace/play/pause with a playbackStatusUpdate listener (assistant.tsx:15,46-55,57-81) - clean implementation, no memory leak (listener removed on unmount).

testID='ai-speak-<index>' is set on Pressable (assistant.tsx:215) using the FlatList item index, so the first assistant reply reliably lands at ai-speak-1 when there is one prior user message - matches task spec.
seed_data_creation: AI chat messages under deviceId 'itest-iter6-tts' created during regression; cleaned up by fixture teardown. TTS cache files remain on backend disk (harmless, intentional cache).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter6 pytest: /app/backend/tests/test_iter6_tts.py. TTS route pattern: POST /api/ai/tts -> {url:'/ai/tts-audio/<sha256>.mp3'}; fetch audio at BASE + '/api' + url. Frontend uses expo-audio (NOT expo-av) - createAudioPlayer / setAudioModeAsync / useAudioRecorder. In headless web the audio element cannot autoplay audibly, but ttsPlayer.play() still transitions state so button text becomes 'Durdur' - verified.
